text.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلذَّٰرِيَٰتِ ذَرْوًۭا

translations.asad: CONSIDER the winds that scatter the dust far and wide,
translations.sahih: By those [winds] scattering [dust] dispersing

text.arabic: فَٱلْحَٰمِلَٰتِ وِقْرًۭا

translations.asad: and those that carry the burden [of heavy clouds],
translations.sahih: And those [clouds] carrying a load [of water]

text.arabic: فَٱلْجَٰرِيَٰتِ يُسْرًۭا

translations.asad: and those that speed along with gentle ease,
translations.sahih: And those [ships] sailing with ease

text.arabic: فَٱلْمُقَسِّمَٰتِ أَمْرًا

translations.asad: and those that apportion [the gift of life] at [God’s] behest!
translations.sahih: And those [angels] apportioning [each] matter,

text.arabic: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَصَادِقٌۭ

translations.asad: Verily, that which you are promised is true indeed,
translations.sahih: Indeed, what you are promised is true.

text.arabic: وَإِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ لَوَٰقِعٌۭ

translations.asad: and, verily, judgment is bound to come!
translations.sahih: And indeed, the recompense is to occur.

text.arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْحُبُكِ

translations.asad: CONSIDER the firmament full of starry paths!
translations.sahih: By the heaven containing pathways,

text.arabic: إِنَّكُمْ لَفِى قَوْلٍۢ مُّخْتَلِفٍۢ

translations.asad: Verily, [O men,] you are deeply at variance as to what to believe:
translations.sahih: Indeed, you are in differing speech.

text.arabic: يُؤْفَكُ عَنْهُ مَنْ أُفِكَ

translations.asad: perverted in his views thereon is he who would deceive himself!
translations.sahih: Deluded away from the Qur'an is he who is deluded.

text.arabic: قُتِلَ ٱلْخَرَّٰصُونَ

translations.asad: They but destroy themselves, they who are given to guessing at what they cannot ascertain –
translations.sahih: Destroyed are the falsifiers

text.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى غَمْرَةٍۢ سَاهُونَ

translations.asad: they who blunder along, in ignorance lost –
translations.sahih: Who are within a flood [of confusion] and heedless.

text.arabic: يَسْـَٔلُونَ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ

translations.asad: they who [mockingly] ask, “When is that Day of Judgment to be?”
translations.sahih: They ask, "When is the Day of Recompense?"

text.arabic: يَوْمَ هُمْ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ يُفْتَنُونَ

translations.asad: [It will be] a Day when they will be sorely tried by the fire,
translations.sahih: [It is] the Day they will be tormented over the Fire

text.arabic: ذُوقُوا۟ فِتْنَتَكُمْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ

translations.asad: [and will be told:] “Taste this your trial! It is this that you were so hastily asking for!”
translations.sahih: [And will be told], "Taste your torment. This is that for which you were impatient."

text.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍ

translations.asad: [But,] behold, the God-conscious will find themselves amid gardens and springs,
translations.sahih: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and springs,

text.arabic: ءَاخِذِينَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُحْسِنِينَ

translations.asad: enjoying all that their Sustainer will have granted them [because], verily, they were doers of good in the past:
translations.sahih: Accepting what their Lord has given them. Indeed, they were before that doers of good.

text.arabic: كَانُوا۟ قَلِيلًۭا مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ

translations.asad: they would lie asleep during but a small part of the night,
translations.sahih: They used to sleep but little of the night,

text.arabic: وَبِٱلْأَسْحَارِ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ

translations.asad: and would pray for forgiveness from their innermost hearts;
translations.sahih: And in the hours before dawn they would ask forgiveness,

text.arabic: وَفِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّۭ لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ

translations.asad: and [would assign] in all that they possessed a due share unto such as might ask [for help] and such as might suffer priva­tion.
translations.sahih: And from their properties was [given] the right of the [needy] petitioner and the deprived.

text.arabic: وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ءَايَٰتٌۭ لِّلْمُوقِنِينَ

translations.asad: AND ON EARTH there are signs [of God’s exis­tence, visible] to all who are endowed with inner certainty,
translations.sahih: And on the earth are signs for the certain [in faith]

text.arabic: وَفِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ ۚ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ

translations.asad: just as [there are signs thereof] within your own selves: can you not, then, see?
translations.sahih: And in yourselves. Then will you not see?

text.arabic: وَفِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزْقُكُمْ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ

translations.asad: And in heaven is [the source of] your sus­tenance [on earth] and [of] all that you are promised [for your life after death]:
translations.sahih: And in the heaven is your provision and whatever you are promised.

text.arabic: فَوَرَبِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقٌّۭ مِّثْلَ مَآ أَنَّكُمْ تَنطِقُونَ

translations.asad: for, by the Sustainer of heaven and earth, this [life after death] is the very truth - as true as that you are endowed with speech!
translations.sahih: Then by the Lord of the heaven and earth, indeed, it is truth - just as [sure as] it is that you are speaking.

text.arabic: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ

translations.asad: AND HAS the story of Abraham’s honoured guests ever come within thy ken?
translations.sahih: Has there reached you the story of the honored guests of Abraham? -

text.arabic: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَٰمًۭا ۖ قَالَ سَلَٰمٌۭ قَوْمٌۭ مُّنكَرُونَ

translations.asad: When those [heavenly messengers] came unto him and bade him peace, he answered, “[And upon you be] peace!” - [saying to himself,] “They are strangers.”
translations.sahih: When they entered upon him and said, "[We greet you with] peace." He answered, "[And upon you] peace, [you are] a people unknown.

text.arabic: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ فَجَآءَ بِعِجْلٍۢ سَمِينٍۢ

translations.asad: Then he turned quietly to his household, and brought forth a fat [roasted] calf,
translations.sahih: Then he went to his family and came with a fat [roasted] calf

text.arabic: فَقَرَّبَهُۥٓ إِلَيْهِمْ قَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ

translations.asad: and placed it before them, saying, “Will you not eat?”
translations.sahih: And placed it near them; he said, "Will you not eat?"

text.arabic: فَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةًۭ ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَٰمٍ عَلِيمٍۢ

translations.asad: [And when he saw that the guests would not eat,] he became apprehensive of them; [but] they said, “Fear not” - and gave him the glad tiding of [the birth of] a son who would be endowed with deep knowledge.
translations.sahih: And he felt from them apprehension. They said, "Fear not," and gave him good tidings of a learned boy.

text.arabic: فَأَقْبَلَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ فِى صَرَّةٍۢ فَصَكَّتْ وَجْهَهَا وَقَالَتْ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٌۭ

translations.asad: Thereupon his wife approached [the guests] with a loud cry, and struck her face [in astonishment] and exclaimed: “A barren old woman [like me]!”
translations.sahih: And his wife approached with a cry [of alarm] and struck her face and said, "[I am] a barren old woman!"

text.arabic: قَالُوا۟ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ

translations.asad: They answered: “Thus has thy Sustainer decreed; and, verily, He alone is truly wise, all- knowing!”
translations.sahih: They said, "Thus has said your Lord; indeed, He is the Wise, the Knowing."

text.arabic: ۞ قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ

translations.asad: Said [Abraham]: “And what [else] may you have in view, O you [heavenly] messengers?”
translations.sahih: [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers?"

text.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍۢ مُّجْرِمِينَ

translations.asad: They answered: “Behold, we have been sent unto a people lost in sin,
translations.sahih: They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals

text.arabic: لِنُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةًۭ مِّن طِينٍۢ

translations.asad: to let loose upon them stone-hard blows of chastisement,
translations.sahih: To send down upon them stones of clay,

text.arabic: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُسْرِفِينَ

translations.asad: marked out in thy Sustainer’s sight for [the punishment of] such as have wasted their own selves.”
translations.sahih: Marked in the presence of your Lord for the transgressors."

text.arabic: فَأَخْرَجْنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

translations.asad: And in the course of time We brought out [of Lot ’s city] such [few] believers as were there:
translations.sahih: So We brought out whoever was in the cities of the believers.

text.arabic: فَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيهَا غَيْرَ بَيْتٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ

translations.asad: for apart from one [single] house We did not find there any who had surrendered themselves to Us.
translations.sahih: And We found not within them other than a [single] house of Muslims.

text.arabic: وَتَرَكْنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَةًۭ لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ

translations.asad: And so We left therein a message for those who fear the grievous suffering [which awaits all evildoers].
translations.sahih: And We left therein a sign for those who fear the painful punishment.

text.arabic: وَفِى مُوسَىٰٓ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ

translations.asad: AND IN [the story of Pharaoh and] Moses, too, [We left the same message: for] when We sent him unto Pharaoh with [Our] manifest authority,
translations.sahih: And in Moses [was a sign], when We sent him to Pharaoh with clear authority.

text.arabic: فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكْنِهِۦ وَقَالَ سَٰحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌۭ

translations.asad: and he turned away in [the pride of] his power and said, “A sorcerer [is this Moses], or a madman!” –
translations.sahih: But he turned away with his supporters and said," A magician or a madman."

text.arabic: فَأَخَذْنَٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذْنَٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌۭ

translations.asad: We seized him and his hosts, and cast them all into the sea: and [none but Pharaoh] himself was to blame [for what happened].
translations.sahih: So We took him and his soldiers and cast them into the sea, and he was blameworthy.

text.arabic: وَفِى عَادٍ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلرِّيحَ ٱلْعَقِيمَ

translations.asad: And [you have the same message] in [what happened to the tribe of] Ad, when We let loose against them that life-destroying wind
translations.sahih: And in 'Aad [was a sign], when We sent against them the barren wind.

text.arabic: مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَىْءٍ أَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتْهُ كَٱلرَّمِيمِ

translations.asad: which spared nothing of what it came upon, but caused [all of] it to become like bones dead and decayed.
translations.sahih: It left nothing of what it came upon but that it made it like disintegrated ruins.

text.arabic: وَفِى ثَمُودَ إِذْ قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَمَتَّعُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍۢ

translations.asad: And in [the story of the tribe of] Thamud, too, when they were told, “You shall enjoy your life for [but] a little while,”
translations.sahih: And in Thamud, when it was said to them, "Enjoy yourselves for a time."

text.arabic: فَعَتَوْا۟ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّٰعِقَةُ وَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ

translations.asad: after they had turned with disdain from their Sustainer’s commandment - whereupon the thunderbolt of punishment overtook them while they were [helplessly] looking on:
translations.sahih: But they were insolent toward the command of their Lord, so the thunderbolt seized them while they were looking on.

text.arabic: فَمَا ٱسْتَطَٰعُوا۟ مِن قِيَامٍۢ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنتَصِرِينَ

translations.asad: for they were unable even to rise, and could not defend themselves.
translations.sahih: And they were unable to arise, nor could they defend themselves.

text.arabic: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍۢ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًۭا فَٰسِقِينَ

translations.asad: And [thus, too, We destroyed] Noah’s people aforetime: for they were iniquitous folk.
translations.sahih: And [We destroyed] the people of Noah before; indeed, they were a people defiantly disobedient.

text.arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بَنَيْنَٰهَا بِأَيْي۟دٍۢ وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ

translations.asad: AND IT IS We who have built the universe with [Our creative] power; and, verily, it is We who are steadily expanding it.
translations.sahih: And the heaven We constructed with strength, and indeed, We are [its] expander.

text.arabic: وَٱلْأَرْضَ فَرَشْنَٰهَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْمَٰهِدُونَ

translations.asad: And the earth have We spread out wide - and how well have We ordered it!
translations.sahih: And the earth We have spread out, and excellent is the preparer.

text.arabic: وَمِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَا زَوْجَيْنِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ

translations.asad: And in everything have We created oppos­ites, so that you might bear in mind [that God alone is One].
translations.sahih: And of all things We created two mates; perhaps you will remember.

text.arabic: فَفِرُّوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ

translations.asad: And so, [O Muhammad, say unto them:] “Flee unto God [from all that is false and evil]! Verily, I am a plain warner to you from Him!
translations.sahih: So flee to Allah. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.

text.arabic: وَلَا تَجْعَلُوا۟ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ

translations.asad: And do not ascribe divinity to aught side by side with God: verily, I am a plain warner to you from Him!”
translations.sahih: And do not make [as equal] with Allah another deity. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.

text.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَتَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا قَالُوا۟ سَاحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ

translations.asad: [But] thus it is: never yet came any apostle to those who lived before their time but they said, “A spellbinder [Lit., "sorcerer".] [is he], or a madman!”
translations.sahih: Similarly, there came not to those before them any messenger except that they said, "A magician or a madman."

text.arabic: أَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِهِۦ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌۭ طَاغُونَ

translations.asad: Have they, perchance, handed down this [way of thinking] as a legacy unto one another? Nay, they are people filled with overweening ar­rogance!
translations.sahih: Did they suggest it to them? Rather, they [themselves] are a transgressing people.

text.arabic: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِمَلُومٍۢ

translations.asad: Turn, then, away from them, and thou shalt incur no blame;
translations.sahih: So leave them, [O Muhammad], for you are not to be blamed.

text.arabic: وَذَكِّرْ فَإِنَّ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ تَنفَعُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

translations.asad: yet go on reminding [all who would listen]: for, verily, such a reminder will profit the believers.
translations.sahih: And remind, for indeed, the reminder benefits the believers.

text.arabic: وَمَا خَلَقْتُ ٱلْجِنَّ وَٱلْإِنسَ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُونِ

translations.asad: And [tell them that] I have not created the invisible beings and men to any end other than that they may [know and] worship Me.
translations.sahih: And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me.

text.arabic: مَآ أُرِيدُ مِنْهُم مِّن رِّزْقٍۢ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَن يُطْعِمُونِ

translations.asad: [But withal,] no sustenance do I ever demand of them, nor do I demand that they feed Me:
translations.sahih: I do not want from them any provision, nor do I want them to feed Me.

text.arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلرَّزَّاقُ ذُو ٱلْقُوَّةِ ٱلْمَتِينُ

translations.asad: for, verily, God Himself is the Provider of all sustenance, the Lord of all might, the Eternal!
translations.sahih: Indeed, it is Allah who is the [continual] Provider, the firm possessor of strength.

text.arabic: فَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ذَنُوبًۭا مِّثْلَ ذَنُوبِ أَصْحَٰبِهِمْ فَلَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونِ

translations.asad: And, verily, they who are bent on doing evil shall have their share [of evil] like unto the share of their fellows [of old]: so let them not ask Me to hasten [their doom]!
translations.sahih: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a portion [of punishment] like the portion of their predecessors, so let them not impatiently urge Me.

text.arabic: فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن يَوْمِهِمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ

translations.asad: For, woe unto those who are bent on denying the truth - [woe] on the Day which they have been promised
translations.sahih: And woe to those who have disbelieved from their Day which they are promised.
